title: Design a metro-site VCF 9.1 architecture and estate migration

network.reason: The task requires genuine consultation of current, reachable Broadcom compatibility and upgrade publications.

reference_patch_apply: git apply -p1 --directory=files reference_fix.patch (from the seed root)
prompt:
Implement the Go package in this repository to produce the VMware Cloud Foundation architecture for the supplied metro-site scenario. Read `testdata/estate.json` for the capacity, availability, site, network, entitlement, and existing-estate inputs. Use `testdata/compatibility-snapshot.json` as the pinned authority for supported topology constraints and component migration targets.

Before finalizing the design, use your own live network research to consult Broadcom's published compatibility, interoperability, bill-of-materials, licensing, and VCF 9.1 upgrade-path sources. Perform real fetches against reachable sources; do not treat the pinned snapshot as a substitute for that research. Record the source title, publisher, reachable URL, date consulted, and the compatibility or upgrade fact used in `research.md`. Source selection and search method are up to you.

Complete `architecture.Build` and generate `architecture.json` with `go run ./cmd/render -out architecture.json`. The JSON must be an architecture artifact, not a prose explanation. It must select a supported topology that meets the fixture's post-site-loss capacity and availability requirements while honoring the supplied VCF instance and stretched-cluster entitlements; identify the otherwise supported topology excluded by the entitlement; place every greenfield host; include the initial deployment and Day-N stretch actions; and contain a greenfield `sddcSpec` for VCF 9.1.0.0. That value must validate as `#/components/schemas/SddcSpec` in the vendored `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json`, taken from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`. Use placeholders, not real secrets, for required credential values.

The same artifact must include an ordered migration plan for every component in the existing-estate inventory. The plan must validate against `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`; each step must name the component, its current version, its target version, its action, and all gates pinned for it in the compatibility snapshot. Do not add components or gates that are absent from the fixture and snapshot.

`go test -race ./...` must pass.
